name: What common issues are found in foreclosed property interiors that need repair?

mainEntity.name: What common issues are found in foreclosed property interiors that need repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common issues in foreclosed property interiors include extensive cosmetic damage like holes in walls, peeling paint, and damaged flooring. Often, you'll find vandalized plumbing fixtures, missing appliances, or non-functional electrical systems due to neglect or theft. Water damage from leaks or burst pipes, mold growth, and pest infestations are also frequent problems that require professional remediation and repair.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common issues include cosmetic damage, vandalized plumbing/electrical, missing appliances, water damage, mold, and pest infestations, all requiring various repairs.
